title: Generated sound (LTX-2.5 audio)
guidance: One flowing present-tense paragraph, under about 200 words.
Start with the main action, then movement and gestures, appearance, environment, camera, lighting and colour.
LTX-2.5 audio: describe ambient sound, put dialogue in quotes with the speaker, name any music.
Sound fragments steer LTX-2.5 audio. Combine one ambience or foley entry with at most one music entry.

entries.label: City ambience
entries.prompt: The soundscape is a city ambience, with distant traffic, a faint siren and the murmur of passing voices.
entries.notes: Ambient bed; keep the dialogue short so it stays clear.

entries.label: Nature ambience
entries.prompt: The soundscape is natural, with wind in leaves, birdsong and the soft trickle of water.
entries.notes: Quiet and wide; good under slow shots.

entries.label: Interior room tone
entries.prompt: The soundscape is a quiet interior room tone, with a low hum, a distant clock tick and soft footsteps on wood.

entries.label: Close foley detail
entries.prompt: Close, crisp foley details are heard, such as fabric rustle, gentle taps, clinking glass and precise footsteps.
entries.notes: Good for macro and product shots.

entries.label: Natural spoken dialogue
entries.prompt: The speaker talks in a natural, relaxed tone, saying a short line in quotes, with clear mouth sync and a close-mic quality.
entries.notes: Put the exact words in quotes and name the speaker. Keep it to one or two short lines.

entries.label: Narrator voice-over
entries.prompt: A calm narrator speaks over the scene, with a warm, steady voice and unhurried pacing.
entries.notes: Quote the narration; keep it brief.

entries.label: Orchestral trailer score
entries.prompt: Music is a building orchestral trailer score, with low strings, deep percussion hits and a rising brass swell.
entries.notes: Rising tension; pairs with speed ramps and impact moments.

entries.label: Ambient synth bed
entries.prompt: Music is a soft ambient synth bed, slow and spacious, with gentle pads and no strong beat.

entries.label: Upbeat pop groove
entries.prompt: Music is an upbeat pop groove, with a bright bassline, crisp claps and a steady danceable beat.
entries.notes: Energetic; suits fast cuts and bright grades.

entries.label: Lo-fi beat
entries.prompt: Music is a mellow lo-fi beat, with dusty drums, warm keys and a relaxed swing.

entries.label: Dark synthwave
entries.prompt: Music is a pulsing dark synthwave track, with an arpeggiated bassline and a driving electronic beat.

entries.label: Near silence
entries.prompt: The scene is almost silent, with only a faint room tone and no music.
entries.notes: Use when you want no generated music.
